text:
Situation: Ephedrine sulfate 5 mg/mL 10 mL single-dose vials are low at Corvale East (33 units, 6.6 days on hand) and adequate at Corvale General (111 units, 18.6 days on hand). The product is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The label identifies Gland Pharma Limited as manufacturer for NDC 68083061010 at FEI 3002647489. FDA inspection records for this facility show Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications from 2012 through 2024. The most recent inspection ended 2024-07-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2025-01-15. No Official Action Indicated classification has been issued.

Our position: Supply is constrained at Corvale East but not system-wide. The repeated VAI history does not establish a regulatory cause for the current low inventory. The manufacturer has not reported production delays or allocation limits to FDA.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 27 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list; plant last inspected VAI 2024-03-21.
3. Purchase from NorthStar RxLLC — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list; plant last inspected VAI 2022-10-29.
4. Purchase from Sandoz Inc — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list.
5. Purchase from Xiromed, LLC — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list; plant last inspected VAI 2022-10-29.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
